summary.text: Laticia Ambroz is the Democratic candidate for the Texas State Senate, District 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Republican incumbent Bryan Hughes.

paragraphs.text: Laticia Ambroz advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for District 1.
In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a citizen of East Texas and listed the Texas economy, healthcare and public education among her key campaign messages.
She said she supports expanding Medicare to keep rural hospitals open, a living wage, and fully funded public schools.
